list.name: Acumen
list.effect: Triples Intellect Modifier for determining Educations and Languages.

list.name: Advocate
list.effect: +2 Support Points at creation and each mission reward.

list.name: Hard-Head
list.effect: Keep half Toughness Modifier vs Headshot; +3 Damage to Headbutts.

list.name: Imposing
list.effect: Increase height up to 20%; weight increases by height% × 2; count as one Size Category larger; +3 Strength and Toughness.

list.name: Olympian
list.effect: Halve penalties from Difficult/Dangerous Terrain, Swimming, and Climbing.

list.name: Poised
list.effect: Shift NPC Disposition up or down one slot during Social Tests.

list.name: Rugged
list.effect: Half penalties and Fatigue from Extreme Temperatures and Cryo.

list.name: Strongman
list.effect: Carry Weight uses full Strength + Toughness (no halving).
